senses.gloss: उप-चिकीर्षु mfn. wishing or intending to do a service or favour, Kathās.; Bālar.
उप-चिकीर्षु See उप- √ 1. कृ.
उपा-चिकीर्षु mfn. (fr. Desid.), one who is about to undertake or commence Comm. on BṛĀrUp.
उपच mfn. See आचोपच.
उप-चक्र m. a species of duck (cf. चक्र and चक्र-वाक), MBh.
उप-चक्षुस् n. a superhuman or divine eye (= दिव्य-चक्षुस्), L.
spectacles (Beng. casamā), T.

उप-चतुरम् ind. nearly four, Gaṇit. 135, Sch.
उप-चय See उप- √ 1. चि.
उप-चय m. accumulation, quantity, heap
elevation, excess
increase, growth, prosperity, MBh.; Suśr.; Hit. &c.
(उपचयं √ 1. कृ, to promote or advance the prosperity of, help, assist, Kām.)
addition, KātyŚr.
the third, sixth, tenth, and eleventh of the zodiacal signs, VarBṛS. &c.

a place for holding sacrificial fire, an altar, hearth, Bhaṭṭ.; L.

उप-च॑र m. access, approach, ŚBr. ii, 3, 4, 30
attendance, cure, Suśr. (cf. सूपचर.)
उप-चार॑ अस्, m. approach, service, attendance, Hcat. i, 111, 2 seqq.
act of civility, obliging or polite behaviour, reverence, ŚBr.; MBh.; Śak. &c. (64 Upacāras are enumerated in the Tantra-sāra, quoted by, T.)
proceeding, practice
behaviour, conduct
mode of proceeding towards (gen.), treatment, ŚBr.; MBh.; Āp.; Mn. &c.
attendance on a patient, medical practice, physicking, Suśr.; Pañcat.; Vikr.
a ceremony, Kum. vii, 86
present, offering, bribe
solicitation, request, L.
ornament, decoration, Kum.; Ragh. vii, 4
a favourable circumstance, Sāh. 300
usage, custom or manner of speech, Nyāyad.

pretence, pretext, L.
a kind of Sandhi (substitution of स् and ष् in place of Visarga), Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 3, 48
N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda.

established use (of a word), Nir. i, 4
a particular Sandhi (see above), APrāt. iv, 74; RPrāt.
उप-चरक m. a spy, Śīl.
उपचारक mf(इका)n. ifc. for उप-चार, Kathās.
उपचारक m. courteousness, politeness, Hcat.
उप-चरण॑ n. approach. See सूपचरण॑.
उप-चरणीय mfn. to be approached
to be attended
to be applied or attributed, Sāy. on TBr. i, 3, 2, 3.
उप-चरध्यै (Ved. inf. of उप. √ चर्), Pāṇ. iii, 4, 9, Sch.
उप-चरित mfn. approached, attended
applied &c.
उप-चरित n. a particular rule of Sandhi (cf. उप-चार), VPrāt.
उपा-चरित m. (in Gr.) a particular Sandhi rule (by which a Visarga in the Pada-pāṭha becomes स् before क् and प् in the Saṃhitā, e.g. य॑स् प॑तिः, RV. x, 24, 3), RPrāt. 260, &c.
उप-चरितव्य mfn. to be attended or waited upon, Bhartṛ.
to be treated, Car.
to be respected or revered or treated with attention, MBh.; R.; Mn.; Pañcat. &c.
उप-चरितव्या f. service, attendance
attendance on a patient
practice of medicine.
1. उप-चर्य mfn. id.
2. उप-चर्य ind.p. having approached, having attended &c.
उप-चर्या f. medical treatment L.
उप-चार्य mfn. to be attended upon, to be treated with attention, Pañcat.
उप-चार्या f. practice of medicine, L.
उप-चारात् ind., metaphorically
उप-चार—करण or उप-चार—कर्मन्, n. or उप-चार—क्रिया, f. (Mn. viii, 357) act of courteousness, politeness, civility.
उप-चार—करण or उप-चार—कर्मन्, n. or उप-चार—क्रिया, f. (Mn. viii, 357) act of courteousness, politeness, civility.
उप-चार—करण or उप-चार—कर्मन्, n. or उप-चार—क्रिया, f. (Mn. viii, 357) act of courteousness, politeness, civility.

उप-चार—च्छल n. a kind of fallacious inference (to be refuted by reference to the real sense of a word used metaphorically, e.g. if any one from the sentence ‘the platform cries’ were to conclude that the platform really cries and not persons on the platform), Nyāyad.; Nyāyak.
उप-चार—पद n. a courteous or polite word, a mere compliment, Kum. iv, 9.
उप-चार—पर mfn. intent on service or politeness.
उप-चार—परिभ्रष्ट mfn. devoid of civility, destitute of kindness, churlish, uncourteous, Hit.
उप-चार—परीत mfn. full of politeness.
उप-चार—वत् mfn. polite
furnished with ornaments, decorated, Ragh. vi; L.
उपचारिक mfn. ifc. serving for, belonging to, MBh. iv, 1621.
उपचारिन् mfn. attending upon, serving
revering, R.; MaitrUp.
ifc. using (a remedy), Car.
उप-चीर्ण mfn. attended upon, assisted, MBh. (= वञ्चित, ‘deceived’, Nīlak.)
उपा-चीर्ण mfn. deceived, MBh. xviii.
उप-चर्म ind. near or on the skin Comm. on Pāṇ.
उपचाकु m. N. of a man g. बाह्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 96 (not in the Kāś.)
1. उप-चायिन् (for 2. See below) mfn. (√ 2. चि), honouring, revering, MBh.
2. उप-चायिन् mfn. ifc. causing to increase or succeed, MBh.
उप-चारु m. N. of a Cakravartin.
उप-चारु—मत् m. id. (Buddh.)
उपचयापचय m. du. prosperity and decay, rise and fall, Suśr.
उपचयावह mfn. causing prosperity or success, Kām.
उपचाय्यक m. id.
उप-चि॑त् f. a particular disease, a kind of swelling, VS. xii, 97, (श्वयथु-गुड-श्लीपदादयः Comm.)
उप-चित mfn. heaped up, increased
thriving, increasing, prospering, succeeding, MBh.; BhP.; Megh.; Ragh. &c.
big, fat, thick, Suśr.; Car.
covered over, furnished abundantly, possessing plentifully, MBh.; Hariv.; Pañcat. &c.
plastered, smeared
burnt, L.
उप-चित—रस mfn. one whose (appetite or) desire is increased, Megh. 115.
उप-चिति f. accumulation, increase
augmentation, Śāntiś.
gain, advantage
a heap, pile, MBh. iii, 15144
(in arithm.) progression, Āryabh. ii, 21.
उपचिती-√ भू to increase, grow, Gīt. xii, 27.
उप-चेय mfn. to be collected or heaped up.
उप-चित्र mfn. variegated, coloured
उप-चित्र m. N. of a man, MBh.
उप-चित्रा f. N. of particular metres (viz. 1. a variety of Mātrāsamaka, consisting of four lines of sixteen instants each; 2. a metre of four lines of eleven instants each; in two varieties)
the plants Salvinia Cucullata and Croton Polyandrum, L.
उपचित्रक n. a particular metre (consisting of four lines of eleven instants each).
उपचीका f. = उपजीका below, AV.Paipp.
उप-चूडन or उप-चूलन n. singeing, searing, heating, Parāś. Comm. on Yājñ. &c.
उप-चूडन or उप-चूलन n. singeing, searing, heating, Parāś. Comm. on Yājñ. &c.

उप-च्छद् (उप-√ छद्).
उप-च्छन्न mfn. covered, MBh. i, 5005
concealed, hidden, secret, MBh. i, 6006; Mn.
उप-च्छन्द m. anything necessary or needful, a requisite, MBh. xiii, 3300.
उप-च्छन्दन n. persuasion, conciliation by coaxing, enticing, Daś.; Bālar., Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 3, 47.
उप-च्छन्दित mfn. persuaded, coaxed, enticed, Śak. 207, 2,(Prākṛt uba-cchandido.)
उप-च्छल् (उप-√ छल्) P. -च्छलयति, to deceive, overreach, Prab.
उप-च्यव॑ अस्, m. (√ च्यु), the act of pressing or moving towards (said of a woman in sexual intercourse), RV. i, 28, 3, (= शाला-प्राप्ति, Sāy.)
उपाच्युतम् ind. in the proximity of A-cyuta or Kṛṣṇa, BhP. x.
